analysisOverview.summary: Three packages carry their own tsconfig.json with the same compiler settings while tsconfig.base.json sits unused. Copy c expands "strict" into its constituent flags, so the repetition is semantic rather than textual. The package.json files repeat by name only — their dependencies, scripts and versions genuinely differ — and were not flagged. No path was recommended for exclusion, since every package still loads its own config at build time.
caveats: redundant_config is advisory: savedTokens stays 0 because nothing is excluded.
